prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: panoramic banner photograph for the project home of a professional local video editing application, Cutroom.
Primary request: an atmospheric but crisp editorial photograph of a real film post-production editing desk. A very tangible graphite-metal video editing controller with a large finely ridged brushed aluminum jog/shuttle wheel, one compact bank of physical keys with a few warm ivory or amber illuminated keycaps, and a single strip of 35mm film catching a narrow amber highlight. A softly out-of-focus cinema monitor in the far background emits a subtle band of steel-blue light.
Composition: wide cinematic landscape, with the controller and clearly visible wheel concentrated on the RIGHT TWO THIRDS, strongest highlight near x=78%, y=55%; left third is the quiet, naturally dark extension of the desk for overlaid interface text. Frame the desk close at an oblique operator's-eye angle; use a single believable surface, crop-safe central horizontal band. Keep the tactile wheel visible in a 3-to-1 banner cut from the center. Gentle film grain; refined analog photographic feeling and calm premium contrast.
Palette: graphite charcoal, brushed slate silver, cool steel-blue, sparing warm amber practical light. Realistic soft box grazing the metal; preserve detail in the light and shadow.
Constraints: one continuous photograph, no graphic design or layout, no titles, no readable letters or numbers, no watermarks, no logos, no human figures, no floating holograms.
